caveat: Informal: a shared 12-core / 24-thread Ryzen with an RTX 3090 while other work ran (load 2 to 10), best or median of a few runs, DuckDB 1.5.1 and pyarrow on the same files in the same minute. The quiet-machine scoreboard has not been run yet.
caveat_short: informal timings: shared 12-core Ryzen + RTX 3090, other work running; quiet-machine scoreboard not run yet
vision: The Mojo engine is the core: it links into any app the way SQLite does, and aims to beat DuckDB and Polars on CPU and GPU. Python and apps are plugins.
vision_short: A data engine kernel in Mojo. Apps and agents build on it; Python is a plugin.
